_: The one source for every algorithm tunable, for all three builds. Edit this file, run tools/gen-rules.py, commit what it writes. Never edit a generated AlgoRules file by hand: the generator overwrites it and the self-check fails.

sections.title: Taste.rank: how a discovery row is scored (the parts add up to 1 before the penalties)

values.name: W_ORDER
values.doc: TMDB's own order (popularity, votes, trending): a row is re-ordered, never shuffled. Was 0.50 / 0.25 when strength hit 1.0 at six titles; under the slower curve 0.45 / 0.30 keeps a six-title viewer about as personal (harness). Acceptance rule for another split: it must lift every warm viewer in the harness while tau over the first twenty stays at or above 0.33 and obscure titles in the first six do not exceed the legacy line's. 40/35 lifts the warm viewers but its tau falls to 0.25 on two of them.

values.name: W_TASTE
values.doc: The profile's affinity for the title, scaled by how well the taste is known.

values.name: W_QUALITY
values.doc: Steadied TMDB score.

values.name: W_FRESH
values.doc: Freshness by release date.

values.name: ART_PENALTY
values.doc: Taken off a landscape card with no backdrop (the poster stands in): art matters, but it is not TMDB's order.

values.name: DAY_ROTATION
values.doc: A per-title, per-day nudge in 0..DAY_ROTATION: the same all day, different tomorrow, so a row's first screen turns over a little each day without a reshuffle while anyone is looking.

values.name: DEEPER_PAGES
values.doc: A row's second fetch is one of this many pages after the first, by the day.

values.name: SPREAD_GAP
values.doc: Titles of one franchise stay at least this many cards apart where the row allows it.

sections.title: Taste.quality: TMDB's score steadied toward a prior by vote count, mapped to 0..1

values.name: QUALITY_UNKNOWN
values.doc: A title with no score at all reads as this.

values.name: QUALITY_LOW
values.doc: Steadied scores map linearly from QUALITY_LOW to QUALITY_LOW + QUALITY_SPAN.

sections.title: Taste signals (STANDARDS section 5: finished titles, My List, opened pages and Trakt only)

values.name: SEED_FINISHED
values.doc: A finished movie, or a finished episode's show.

values.name: SEED_EPISODES
values.doc: A show the viewer finishes episodes of (an Up Next queued, or episodes in the Watched ledger).

values.name: KEPT_AFTER_EPISODES
values.doc: Episodes of a show the viewer must have finished before clearing its Continue Watching card stops counting as "not for me". The rule it bends is there to keep a quick sample out of the profile; someone this many episodes in is not sampling, they are between seasons, and losing the signal would be the bigger error.

values.name: STRENGTH_SCALE
values.doc: strength = 1 - exp(-weight / STRENGTH_SCALE): about 0.22 from one fresh finished title, 0.63 from four, 0.78 from six, 0.95 from twelve. Diminishing returns, never a hard ceiling at six.

values.name: OPENED_STRENGTH_CAP
values.doc: Opened pages shape affinities in full but count toward strength only up to this much weight (browsing isn't watching).

sections.title: Home's "for you" rows and the genre order on Movies / TV Shows

values.name: HERO_ORDER_POOL
values.doc: The chart position's worth, spread over the pool (two trending pages).

values.name: HERO_MOMENT_FLOOR
values.doc: The clock's terms (HERO_MOMENT, HERO_MOVIE_LEAN) are scaled by max(this, 1 - strength): a known taste leads, the clock breaks ties.

values.name: HERO_TYPE
values.doc: Movies against shows by the profile's own share, scaled by strength: up to this much either way.

sections.title: RowMix.tidy: what no discovery row shows

values.name: OBSCURE_VOTES_MOVIE
values.doc: Below this many votes a title in a language the profile doesn't watch in counts as obscure.

values.name: OWN_LANGUAGE_MIN
values.doc: A list this long or longer that is at least half one language adopts that language as its own.
